description:
We are looking for a skilled Data Scientist to join our Analytics team.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
- Strong proficiency in Python and R programming languages
- Experience with Machine Learning frameworks: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost
- Deep knowledge of NLP techniques: TF-IDF, Word2Vec, BERT, spaCy, NLTK, Sentiment Analysis, Named Entity Recognition
- Proficiency in Data Science libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly
- Statistical Analysis, Hypothesis Testing, A/B Testing, and EDA skills
- Database skills: SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
- Experience with Feature Engineering, Data Cleaning, Data Preprocessing
- Machine Learning algorithms: Random Forest, Decision Trees, Gradient Boosting, SVM, KNN, Logistic Regression, Linear Regression, K-Means, DBSCAN
- Neural Networks, Deep Learning, CNN, RNN, LSTM knowledge
- MLOps tools: MLflow, Docker, Git, GitHub
- Cloud experience: AWS or GCP preferred
- Strong Communication, Problem Solving, and Analytical Skills
- Experience with Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab
- Visualization tools: Tableau or Power BI preferred
- Knowledge of Cross-Validation, Model Evaluation, Hyperparameter Tuning

Responsibilities:
- Develop and deploy machine learning models for business problems
- Perform exploratory data analysis on large datasets
- Build and maintain data pipelines using Python and SQL
- Present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Collaborate in Agile team environment

We are hiring a Full Stack Developer for our product team.

Required Skills:
- Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript
- Frontend: React, Angular, or Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap
- Backend: Node.js, Django, Flask, FastAPI, REST API design
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
- Cloud and DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS or Azure, CI/CD, GitHub Actions
- Version control: Git, GitHub
- Testing: Unit testing, pytest, Jest
- Agile/Scrum methodology
- Communication, Teamwork, Problem Solving skills
- Linux experience preferred
- Experience with microservices architecture
- API documentation: Swagger, Postman

Responsibilities:
- Design and develop scalable web applications
- Build RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services
- Write clean, maintainable code with proper documentation
- Participate in code reviews and Agile ceremonies
- Deploy and monitor applications on cloud infrastructure

We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer.

Required Qualifications:
- Expert-level Python programming
- Machine Learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM
- Deep Learning: CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformer, BERT, Generative AI, LLMs
- NLP: spaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face, Sentiment Analysis, NER, Text Classification, Text Summarization
- Computer Vision: OpenCV, object detection, image segmentation
- MLOps: MLflow, Weights & Biases, ONNX, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
- Cloud: AWS, GCP, or Azure with ML services
- Data: Pandas, NumPy, Feature Engineering, Data Pipelines
- SQL and NoSQL databases
- Git, GitHub, collaborative development
- Strong Mathematical background: Linear Algebra, Calculus, Probability, Statistics
- Reinforcement Learning and Transfer Learning knowledge preferred
- Technical Writing, Research, Documentation
- Leadership and Mentoring experience a plus

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and deploy production ML systems
- Optimize model performance and inference speed
- Collaborate with data engineers and software developers
- Monitor models in production and handle model drift
- Write technical documentation and research reports

We are looking for a Data Analyst to support business decision-making.

Required Skills:
- Proficiency in Python and SQL
- Data Analysis and Data Visualization using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly
- Business Intelligence tools: Tableau, Power BI, Excel
- Statistical Analysis, Hypothesis Testing, A/B Testing
- Database skills: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- EDA and Data Cleaning experience
- Strong Communication and Presentation Skills
- Excel, Google Sheets proficiency
- Git version control
- Attention to Detail and Analytical Skills

Responsibilities:
- Analyze large datasets to extract business insights
- Create dashboards and reports for stakeholders
- Support data-driven decision making
- Maintain data quality and documentation
- Collaborate with business and engineering teams

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our engineering team.

Required Skills:
- Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or C++
- Data Structures and Algorithms proficiency
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
- SQL and basic database knowledge
- Git and GitHub version control
- Linux/Unix environment experience
- REST API development
- Problem Solving and Critical Thinking
- Communication and Teamwork
- Agile/Scrum familiarity

Preferred:
- Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Docker basics
- Testing frameworks (pytest, JUnit)
- CI/CD knowledge

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement software solutions
- Write clean, well-documented code
- Participate in code reviews
- Debug and resolve software issues
- Collaborate in cross-functional teams
